why: Recovery is better judged by patterns in function, confidence, symptoms, and participation than by one difficult day.

slides.title: Recovery Has Variation
slides.content: Symptoms, energy, confidence, and ability can rise and fall. A variable path can still be moving forward.

slides.title: Use More Than Pain
slides.content: Notice whether you can do more, recover more predictably, understand your response, or participate with greater confidence—even when pain has not disappeared.

slides.title: Zoom Out
slides.content: Compare weeks rather than hours. Ask: What is easier now? What is more consistent? What still needs adjustment?

slides.title: Your Plan Is Individual
slides.content: There is no universal recovery timeline. Your presentation, goals, health, environment, and response should shape the next step.

slides.title: Try This Today
slides.content: Write down one sign of progress that is not simply a lower pain score, and one part of the plan that may need support.
